Guide & Academy/BA Lending Academy/Module 12

Module 12 of 15

Secured lending, finance and portfolio control

Follow value, legal rights and accounting evidence from valuation through release.

Secured and institutional lending adds linked lifecycles that generic origination lessons miss: collateral, perfection, custody, accounting, reconciliation and regulatory reporting. This module teaches a BA to keep those books aligned.

4 lessons101 min guided timeComplete in sequence

Lesson 12.1 · 25 min

Collateral from proposal to release

  • Model collateral independently from a loan
  • Trace valuation, eligibility and monitoring
  • Define substitution and release controls

Lesson 12.2 · 24 min

Legal due diligence and security perfection

  • Separate ownership, title and encumbrance checks
  • Map perfection by asset type
  • Handle exceptions without pretending security exists

Lesson 12.3 · 27 min

Subledger, GL and reconciliation

  • Trace a business event into balanced accounting
  • Explain suspense and value dating
  • Design three-way reconciliation and repair

Lesson 12.4 · 25 min

Portfolio measures, regulatory returns and lineage

  • Define portfolio measures without denominator ambiguity
  • Trace report fields to source events
  • Specify filing, rejection and amendment workflows
